description: Nouvelle-Aquitaine : TRI de Bordeaux - Données géolocalisées produites par le SIG Directive inondation du territoire à risque d'inondation de Bordeaux is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. The IRR flood and flood risk maps were approved on 03 December 2014 by Prefectural Order No 2014337-0002. The geostandard Flood Directive describes the basis of geographical data produced on territories with significant flood risk (TRI) and mapped for reporting purposes for the European Flood Directive. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "New-Aquitaine: Sort of Bordeaux — Geolocation data produced by the GIS Flood Directive of Bordeaux flood risk territory" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inondation, tri, risque, surfaces inondables, Bordeaux, directive inondation. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
